verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents configuring fields to match a sales methodology and building custom sales apps. Its Dataverse Web API references tables, related rows, and navigation properties. However, no evidence explicitly documents defining new custom tables or relationships beyond the built-in accounts, contacts, and opportunities. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating custom tables/entities, defining custom relationships between them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals

citations.quote: Easily configure fields, dashboards, and views to match your organization’s sales methodology.
Build custom sales apps, automate business processes, and enrich seller experiences—all tailored to your unique business needs.
Send a `POST` request to create table rows, including related rows in a single deep insert operation.
